title: Geoffrey Strickland
name: Geoffrey Bedford Strickland
html: Geoffrey Strickland, JD, JCL, LLM, is an international lawyer focusing on dispute settlement and human rights advocacy. He served the Holy See for over 10 years as a legal analyst with the Pontifical Council for the Family, as facilitator of the Forum of Catholic-inspired Non-governmental Organizations and as a translator for various Vatican offices. His research interests include the nexus of law, language and interpretation, as well as human rights synergies in civil society.
